artifact_observations.location: Top face, surrounding the central logo
artifact_observations.reasoning: The circular text is nonsensical, malformed, and bleeds into the background. This is a classic AI generation artifact where the model mimics the structure of text without understanding character formation.

The logo has a 'painted on' or decal-like quality that lacks the physical integration of ink into rubber. The edges of the blue shield are slightly soft and irregular, lacking the crispness of a real printed logo.
